title: Valero Natural Gas: Private Meeting, No Action
summary:
*   A special meeting was held to discuss issues related to Valero Natural Gas.
*   The entire session was conducted privately as an executive session.
*   No public actions, votes, or policy decisions were made during the meeting.
*   The meeting was brief, adjourning after approximately 35 minutes in executive session.
